row: CBS 17, also known by call letters WNCN, is the local CBS affiliate serving Raleigh, Durham, Fayetteville and surrounding communities in North Carolina. We share award-winning journalism, professional-quality content, and powerful human stories.  This channel is not just for breaking daily news or weather forecasts - it's where you can also find original shows streaming on CBS 17 PLUS!
